projects.title: AI Assisted Portfolio
projects.description: A modern, AI-driven personal portfolio acting as a 'Keshore Assistant' built with Next.js 15 and Tailwind CSS. It features a sophisticated interactive chatbot powered by LLM that allows recruiters to inquire about skills and experience in real-time. The application utilizes MongoDB for persistent chat history and Framer Motion for high-end aesthetic animations.

projects.title: Zomato Data Scraper
projects.description: A Python automation project designed to process website data programmatically across multiple locations. It utilizes XPath for precise element location and handles pagination to run scripts sequentially for large datasets. The tool logs progress in the terminal and was tested across three different towns to analyze workflow behavior with varying data sizes.

projects.title: Expense Tracker
projects.description: A finance management dashboard designed to analyze income and expenditure through visual analytics. It features secure authentication, CSV export/import capabilities, and a user-friendly interface for tracking real-time financial health.

projects.title: Croyez Clothing Store
projects.description: Developed a full-stack e-commerce site for men's fashion using React, Node.js, and MongoDB with secure payments and admin inventory control.

projects.title: College Hostel Portal
projects.description: A comprehensive management system built using Flask and MySQL to streamline hostel operations. It offers features like secure multi-role authentication, automated room booking with occupancy tracking, and a digital outpass management system. The project is currently evolving into 'Hostel-v2' with a React-based frontend for a modular architecture.

projects.title: Billing Software System
projects.description: A comprehensive billing solution built with Python and Tkinter that streamlines invoicing and payment tracking. It features distinct Admin and Employee login modes for secure access to inventory and sales data. The system uses a normalized MySQL database to manage customers, products, and transactions efficiently. Key functions include automated bill generation, tax calculation, and real-time reporting.

projects.title: Smart Post Box
projects.description: Conceptual smart post box system for detecting deliveries and notifications using sensors and automation logic.
